quarterly_data.signal: Quantum computing (government program): a joint R&D project of NEC, Taiho Pharmaceutical, the Japanese Foundation for Cancer Research, AIST and Waseda University, 'Development and Demonstration of a Computational and Evaluation Platform for Next-Generation Cancer Immunotherapy Using Quantum Computing Technology', was selected for NEDO's Large-Scale Demonstration for Use Case Creation under its Post-5G information and communication infrastructure R&D project. It runs from September 2026 to March 2029, using AI to predict and score immune responses to neoantigen candidates and quantum computing technology to design the amino-acid sequences flanking the neoantigen core, on the ABCI-Q quantum / HPC / AI computing infrastructure being developed by AIST's G-QuAT.
